description: Smarte Strasse: Parkplatzbelegung is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kanton Basel-Stadt. Der Datensatz zeigt die Anzahl besetzter und freier Parkplätze in den beiden Zonen «blau» und «gelb».Die Detektion freier Parkplätze mittels Kamera befindet sich noch in der Testphase. Coverage: Kanton Basel-Stadt. The portal files it under the publisher Kanton Basel-Stadt. It offers 9 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, JSON-LD, N3, PARQUET. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
